subject: Downtown was a problem for me
author: ZombieTron
body:
I had one last smash in Downtown for ages, but I got it in the end.

If the map isn't helping at all, I don't know what to suggest, except for patience. Drive around looking for any seemingly inaccessible areas as a lot of the smashes are up high, or underground.

I didn't have any problems with the Harbor Town ones, so I don't know which one you are struggling with.

Good Luck! 🙂
